services.desc: Subliminal Projects and General Admission teamed up with artists Hassan Rahim, Nathan Bell, and Buckley on a series of limited edition screen prints to bring awareness to a handful of non-profits. All profits supported the artists, the Los Angeles-based non-profit World Harvest Food Bank, and a non-profit of each artist’s choice dedicated to racial justice and equality. The prints were released Friday, November 26, 2020, on generaladmission.com. GALLERY HOURS: The gallery is temporarily closed to the public.
